lead.t: Look‑alike conditions: drug‑induced parkinsonism (antipsychotics, metoclopramide), essential tremor, progressive supranuclear palsy, multiple system atrophy, vascular parkinsonism.

snip.t: Look‑alike conditions: drug‑induced parkinsonism (antipsychotics, metoclopramide), essential tremor, progressive supranuclear palsy, multiple system atrophy, vascular parkinsonism.
“What feature distinguishes Parkinson tremor from essential tremor?” (resting, improves with action).
Hypertension with AF, angina, essential tremors, migraine: Beta blockers (monotherapy not recommended unless other indications for their use present along with hypertension)
